name: Albesa (Spain)
description: Green field charged with a white poplar tree, with a chequy stripe of two rows of yellow and black squares along the lower edge.
history: The official flag of Albesa is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with the white poplar of the arms, 3/6 of the height of the cloth, at the centre, and a chequy fess of two rows of nine yellow and black squares; approved on 22 December 1999 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: chequy stripe of two rows of nine squares along the lower edge
